title: The AI infrastructure race
thesis: Durable AI advantage depends on repeatedly converting intelligence into dependable large-scale capacity across compute, power, land, construction and finance.

title: Energy becomes strategic capacity
thesis: Reliable energy access increasingly determines where strategic digital and industrial capacity can grow.

title: Semiconductor capacity becomes geopolitical infrastructure
thesis: Semiconductor advantage depends on coordinated manufacturing ecosystems, policy, equipment, talent and allied supply chains.

title: Technology control becomes geopolitical infrastructure
thesis: The geography of technological growth is increasingly shaped by security policy, alliances and controlled access to critical capacity.
